To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the price effect on the choice probability is decomposed into two channels: the pure price effect and the price perceived quality effect, and that there is a large heterogeneity among the price perceived quality effects.

(i) the price effect on perceived quality is an important channel of the total price effect on choice probability; (ii) the price effect through the channel of perceived quality varies across products, (iii) and the perceived quality effect is larger for the first purchase than the repeat purchases.
(i) price affects the perceived product quality and (ii) the impact of price on perceived quality decreases after repeat purchases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the price impact on choice probability through perceived quality.
the price perceived quality relationship and the heterogeneity in the relationship.
the impact of price on consumer choice behavior.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a higher price would lead to a lower probability of choosing the cheese product due to the increase in the perceived product quality.
the price effect on consumer choice is a function of both the pure price effect and the perceived quality effect.
the price perceived quality relationship exists and the impact of price on perceived quality is significant and varies across products and over repeat purchases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the price perceived quality relationship is important in understanding the consumer behavior.
the perceived quality channel should be included in price elasticity studies.
price has a large influence on consumer choice probability through the price perceived quality channel and this effect is highly heterogeneous.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the price perceived quality relationship should be considered as an important factor in the analysis of price competition and consumer response to price change.
price affects the perceived product quality, which is a key factor that determines the choice probability.
a product's perceived quality is an important factor for consumers to choose a product.
